# devin_blueprint_file (Resource)

Uploads a file attached to a snapshot setup blueprint. Blueprint steps read it through the environment variable in env_var_name. Files can't be edited in place, so any change replaces the file. Devin doesn't return file contents, so only a deleted file is detected as drift.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Maven settings available to the blueprint's steps through the file's
# env_var_name.
resource "devin_blueprint_file" "maven_settings" {
  org_id         = devin_organization.frontend.org_id
  blueprint_id   = devin_blueprint.org.blueprint_id
  name           = "settings.xml"
  content_base64 = filebase64("${path.module}/files/settings.xml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blueprint_id` (String) Blueprint the file is attached to.
- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded file contents, e.g. filebase64("${path.module}/files/settings.xml").
- `name` (String) File name.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization of an org-wide or repository blueprint. Omit for the enterprise blueprint.

### Read-Only

- `env_var_name` (String) Environment variable holding the file's path during blueprint steps.
- `file_id` (String) File ID (assigned by Devin).
- `size_bytes` (Number) File size in bytes.
